name: repo-platform-new-project
description: Create or adopt a repository managed by Vivswan/repo-platform: write the registration, grant the fleet token, run the first sync, review its report, and watch the first CI run.

interface.shortDescription: Bring a repository under repo-platform fleet management.
interface.longDescription: Walks the creation or adoption of a repo-platform managed repository: the native scaffold, the .repo-platform.yml registration (modules plus the keys whose defaults are wrong), the fleet token grant that enrolls it, the first sync dispatch, the sync PR report, and the CI jobs every managed repository shares.
defaultPrompt: Create a new project managed by repo-platform.
Set this repo up like my other repos.
Bring this repository into the fleet.
